result.question: Quais são os 3 hospitais com maior custo médio de UTI por estado (MA e RS)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT estado, "CNES", ROUND(custo_medio_uti, 2) AS custo_medio_uti FROM (SELECT mu.estado, h."CNES", AVG(i."VAL_UTI") AS custo_medio_uti, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mu.estado ORDER BY AVG(i."VAL_UTI") DESC) AS rn FROM internacoes i JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" JOIN municipios mu ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE i."VAL_UTI" > 0 AND mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.estado, h."CNES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 100) sub WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY estado, rn;
